status: behavioral research model for architecture-level PIM estimation

xor_primitive.name: PIM_XOR_3M_CONSERVATIVE
xor_primitive.description: A conservative stateful XOR abstraction using two operand cells and one destination/scratch cell. The Boolean result is stored as a memristor resistance state.
pulses: stateful XOR fire pulse writes destination state

acceptance_criteria.note: The model is suitable for project-level research estimation. A future Verilog-A or LTspice compact-device calibration is still required before silicon-level claims.
